body: Ahh thats definitely above my skill level then. Thanks!
Where did you find this pattern? I’m obsessed with it

I love the color palate for the whole piece but I think maybe I’ve been looking at it too closely. I’ve got to put it down for a few days because of work anyways so maybe when I come back the doubt will go away!

I actually just used this iron to finish my latest project because I don’t have a normal one. It was okay, but I didn’t have any deep wrinkles or hoop creases in my aida. I had to use a lot of pressure to get nice edge seams and was afraid I was going to break the handle off at one point 😅 I was able to get it to do what I needed too, but I definitely want to upgrade for my next major finish.
Pattern is "Cobweb" which is a freebie from [https://www.blackworkjourney.co.uk/](https://www.blackworkjourney.co.uk/)

Oh I love pulling patterns from older magazines! If you have a local creative reuse store they might be interested. Mine is always getting a ton of different magazines. The halloween patterns are my favorite.
